name: Adult-Onset Still Disease
definition: Systemic inflammatory disease with spiking fever, inflammatory arthritis and evanescent rash after excluding infection and malignancy.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical with exclusion of infection/malignancy; inflammatory markers and ferritin support assessment.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Jwara/Shotha phenotype may be documented only after modern exclusion of infection/malignancy.

patientEducation.summary: Systemic inflammatory disease with spiking fever, inflammatory arthritis and evanescent rash after excluding infection and malignancy.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
